decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed installation of a vehicular crossover to the existing dwellinghouse will not be detrimental the existing dwellinghouse or have any associated negative impacts on the adjoining dwellings or surrounding area. The proposal has been designed in accordance with the provisions of Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV - B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, Section 11 of the Unitary Development Plan - Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997) and Section 8 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 6 - That the existing vehicular crossover is to be reinstated at the applicants expense prior to the construction of the new crossover.
